purpose: Run the mandatory G4 baseline family on one frozen background-only likelihood before G5, without extending unimplemented perturbation prescriptions to growth/CMB observables.

cosmic_chronometers.selection: source begins with CC_ and excludes labels containing BAO
cosmic_chronometers.reason: avoid silently double-counting legacy BAO-derived H(z) alongside DESI DR2 BAO without a cross-covariance

pantheon_plus.nuisance: M_B analytically profiled and counted in k

excluded_from_this_gate.fsigma8: requires model-specific perturbation/growth closure; deferred to G8/G9
excluded_from_this_gate.CMB_full_or_compressed: GEDE/IDE/RLL perturbation/early-time consistency must be implemented before fair CMB comparison
excluded_from_this_gate.reason: same-data fairness does not authorize applying one model's approximate perturbation proxy to another model

IDE_QrhoLambda.prior_provenance: paper uses beta in [-0.15,0.15] for Q proportional to rho_Lambda

shared_physics_policy.sound_horizon: same repository calibrated rd(H0,Omega_m,omega_b_h2) approximation for every model
shared_physics_policy.distances: same flat comoving-distance integration grid and interpolation
shared_physics_policy.optimizer: same multistart L-BFGS-B implementation, seeds, maxiter and ftol
shared_physics_policy.information_criteria: k counts H0, Omega_m, omega_b_h2, model-specific free parameters and profiled M_B

pass_when: all six model optimizations return finite results
all three extension null limits are numerically verified
all models consume identical selected observations and covariance blocks
parameter counts and information criteria are emitted
stop_when: a model receives a different data selection without a declared domain reason
growth/CMB is silently applied without perturbation closure
